venue.name: Helmcken House
venue.description: Helmcken House is a historic house on the east side of the Royal BC Museum building, in the museum's free outdoor Cultural Precinct in downtown Victoria. It was built in 1852 by Dr. John Sebastian Helmcken, a surgeon with the Hudson's Bay Company and son-in-law of Governor James Douglas, and the museum describes it as one of the oldest houses in British Columbia still standing on its original site; the doctor's original 19th century medical kit is among the items on display. It is not open every day: the museum states that Helmcken House 'is typically open during July and August, the weekends in December and other special events throughout the year' and directs visitors to check the events page for opening hours. As of 3 September 2026 no Helmcken House opening appears in the events the museum is showing. A 360-degree virtual walk-through of the house and the neighbouring St. Ann's Schoolhouse is linked from the museum's site.
venue.hours_notes: Check the events page for opening hours. Helmcken House is typically open during July and August, the weekends in December and other special events throughout the year.
venue.seasonal_notes: The museum's event listings include a Helmcken House Open House and a Helmcken House Old-Fashioned Christmas. Neither appears among the events the museum was showing for 3 September 2026 or for the next listed dates of 12 and 18 September 2026.

programs.name: Helmcken House Open House
programs.description: A drop-in visit to the historic house on the east side of the museum building, run on published dates. The museum writes: 'Helmcken House was built by Dr. John Sebastian Helmcken, a surgeon with the Hudson's Bay Company. It is one of the oldest houses in British Columbia still on its original site.' The doctor's original 19th century medical kit is among the items on display. No admission price, opening times, duration, capacity or group booking route is published for the open house; the museum names Chris O'Connor, Program Developer, as the contact, and links a 360-degree virtual tour for visitors who cannot come in person.
programs.what_children_do: Walk through the rooms of a small 1852 house and look at the furnishings and objects on display, including Dr. Helmcken's original 19th-century medical kit.
programs.our_note: Only plan around this one once you have a date confirmed. The house is shut most of the year and opens for July and August, weekends in December and occasional events. Email the program developer before you build a trip around it, because nothing on the site says whether a class or a daycare group can come in together or how many people fit inside at once.
programs.practical_summary: A small historic house in the museum's free outdoor Cultural Precinct, open only on published dates. Admission price, hours, capacity, washrooms and step-free access are not stated for the house itself.
programs.evidence: Come visit historic Helmcken House, on the east side of the museum building.
